title: Therapy Intake Form
subtitle: Capture patient goal, referral source, intake boundary, and clinician match; confirm schedule and follow-up.
description: Therapy records patient goal, referral source, intake boundary, clinician match, schedule, and follow-up. Therapy evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this therapy structured intake when staff must document patient goal and referral source. Reconcile intake boundary, clinician match, schedule, and follow-up before the therapy handoff. Use the referral or self-request, patient goal, screening source, clinician-match record, availability calendar, communication preference, initial plan, and follow-up appointment. This coordination record centers a person's stated therapy goal, referral or self-request, therapist matching, modality and scheduling preferences, engagement handoff, and continuing follow-up. Track provider-panel availability, session cadence, office or remote preference, continuity contact, attendance outreach, rescheduling pattern, and ongoing appointment ownership. Ask the assigned therapy reviewer to confirm patient goal against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Therapy starting details review
sections.guidance: Preserve patient goal and referral source, explain intake boundaries, route urgent concerns, match clinician and modality, schedule access, and record follow-up. Keep any urgent therapy issue with its escalation contact and time.

sections.title: Therapy exception review and reported needs
sections.guidance: Preserve the person's wording and route questions without interpretation.

fields.label: Person's words, desired outcome, and priority

blocks.label: Therapy intake readiness
items: Patient goal is identified for this record
Referral source matches the current request or source
Intake boundary is ready for point-of-use staff
Clinician match limits or questions are resolved
Schedule is communicated to the responsible person

sections.title: Therapy receiving route and handoff
sections.guidance: Assign open questions and confirm where the intake goes next.

blocks.label: Therapy intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms routing, not professional review.
